_comment: Template for the Ethereum mainnet deployment. The auction values are the decided launch settings (checklists/1-pre-deploy.md); on chain 1 script/DeployKilim.s.sol refuses any other value, a skipped nonce check and a zero minLeadSeconds. Copy it, fill every TODO, get it signed off, then follow checklists/2-deploy.md and docs/RENDERER.md. The expected values come from onchain/build/manifest.json once the symbol set is final; rendererHash stays zero until runStore prints it.
deployerNonce: TODO: the published nonce for the auction transaction
minLeadSeconds: TODO: the inspection window in seconds, nonzero (for example 86400)

expected.motifCount: TODO: motifCount from the final onchain/build/manifest.json
expected.geometryHash: TODO: hashes.geometryHash from the final manifest
expected.indexHash: TODO: hashes.indexHash from the final manifest
expected.pageHash: TODO: hashes.pageHash from the final manifest

auction.startsAt: TODO: unix seconds, at least minLeadSeconds after deployment
